title: Student Score Record System
description: Web application in progress where school administrators import students, subjects and marks from Google Sheets, and students see their results across five terms with every mark and weight explained.
highlights: Built term workbook sync, where administrators connect one Google Sheet per term and confirm each subject and its weights before syncing.
Added reviewed and previewed sheet replacement, so marks change only when the new sheet's sync succeeds.
Wrote QA suites covering authentication, data isolation, sync, fault handling and the UI.

title: Employee Management System (EMS)
description: Backend for the Attendance Service of a microservice-based HR platform at APD Bank, covering shift management, schedule assignment, attendance tracking and leave handling.
highlights: Built shift creation and attendance schedule assignment, calculating working hours from clock in/out times with late and early detection.
Implemented a leave type service with pro-rata and carry-over leave balance calculations.
Built cursor-paginated queries combining shifts and holiday/day-off records for large datasets.
Designed a permission seeder for the Time & Attendance module with about 65 entries and role-based scoping.
Defined REST API contracts with frontend developers for shift, schedule and attendance screens.

title: APD Chat System (APD-CS)
description: Backend for a real-time internal chat platform at APD Bank, covering admin reporting, messaging security, API performance and production stability.
highlights: Improved chat history API latency from about 400ms to about 14ms using Redis-based user validation, cursor pagination and database projections.
Implemented WebSocket/STOMP subscription authorization that validates users against chatroom membership and destination rules.
Built reporting services for daily, monthly and yearly metrics on message volume, file storage and user activity.
Resolved production incidents including RabbitMQ consumer failures and MinIO storage overload.

title: Admin Management System (AMS)
description: Reminder and room booking features for an internal admin platform at APD Bank, plus hardened approval workflows.
highlights: Built a cron-based service running every 5 minutes to detect due reminders and push notifications through the internal chat system.
Added admin-only authorization on booking history and workflow approval actions to address penetration test findings.
Diagnosed production issues, including a workflow approval failure caused by a database remark-type mismatch.

title: Go Ahead Organization Website
description: Public website for the Go Ahead organization to showcase programs, drive donor engagement and support fundraising.
highlights: Built the site with Astro using Vue and React components.
Developed a secure contact form with Nodemailer/SMTP and input sanitization.
Created a donation page with segmented flows for individual, corporate and institutional donors.

title: Kheobs Website
description: WordPress website for Kheobs, an NGO client, built at Passerelles Numériques Cambodia.
highlights: Led a team to build and launch the website, including Facebook and email integration.
Configured and deployed the site on Nginx with a custom domain.
Managed sprints and task distribution in Jira, and led testing and bug resolution.

title: POS Management System
description: Multi-user point-of-sale system for a phone retail shop, covering stock in/out tracking and profit reporting by day, month and year.
highlights: Led the team and designed the system architecture, database schema and business workflows.
Deployed and maintained the system on AWS.
Managed sprints in Jira and led testing and bug resolution.

title: Face Detection & Attendance System
description: Real-time face detection and recognition system that automates check-in and check-out via webcam.
highlights: Added late-arrival detection, text-to-speech name announcements and a face-registration flow for new users.
Led a team through planning, coding, testing and debugging as a practical application of algorithms coursework.
